column1: # OCN-1 conformance corpus - slugs that MUST be rejected.
# Two tab-separated columns: slug, reason_code. Lines starting with '#'
# are comments; blank lines are ignored.
# The slug column may carry \uXXXX escapes (four hex digits) so that
# characters a TSV cannot hold literally - tab, space, the separator
# glyph banned project-wide - are still testable. Decode the escapes
# before parsing. See README.md for the reason codes and for the order
# --- G-EMPTY-SEGMENT: a dot-delimited segment is empty ---
# --- G-CLASS: first segment is not exactly one of A B C D E ---
# --- G-CHAR: a character outside the token-char set ---
# --- CP-2: non-root slug with no named segment ---
# --- CP-3: named token neither 3 characters nor registered ---
# --- CP-4: named token is all lowercase ASCII letters ---
# --- CP-5: SAN-shaped named token outside the grandfathered table ---
